text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's information minister hopes Gulf Arab committee chaired by Saudi Arabia will reach a formula to settle a territorial dispute with Qatar over small islands in the Gulf.
- Bahrain's non-oil exports, including re-export, to other Arab Gulf states amounted to 118 million dinars in the first nine months of 1995.
- Kuwait Oil Company is recommended to receive $600 million in damages for oil well fires set by departing Iraqi troops at the end of the Gulf War.
- Egypt Airways receives first aircraft out of three it ordered to boost its services in the Middle East.
- Bahrain Maritime and Mercantile International Co signs a contract to build new premises at a cost of four million dinars.
